run_grpc_client: run the gRPC client to call all four data transmission methods on localhost:23333
run_simple_method: run the unary-unary gRPC call sending a single request and receiving a single response
run_client_streaming_method: run the client streaming gRPC call sending multiple requests and receiving one response
run_server_streaming_method: run the server streaming gRPC call sending one request and receiving multiple responses
run_bidirectional_streaming_method: run the bidirectional streaming gRPC call sending and receiving multiple messages simultaneously
